title: Word order in questions & relative clauses
subtitle: English File B1 · Grammar, the alphabet & speaking accuracy

notification.description: Practise forming questions in the present and past, using who / which / that in relative clauses, and recognising English alphabet vowel sounds. You’ll also review the key vocabulary.

blocks.title: 1 · Which question is correct?
blocks.instructions: Choose the question with the correct word order.

items.prompt: Which is correct: “Are you hungry?” / “Do you hungry?”

options: How often the bus stops here?
How often does the bus stop here?

blocks.title: 2 · Build the questions
blocks.instructions: Write a complete question using the prompts in brackets. Use the tense shown.

items.prompt: they / travel / by train? (Present Simple)
your friends / study / online? (Present Simple)
items.answer: Do your friends study online?

items.prompt: what / Sam / order / for dinner? (Past Simple)
items.answer: What did Sam order for dinner?

items.prompt: where / your aunt / work? (Present Simple)
items.answer: Where does your aunt work?

items.prompt: you / be / at home / yesterday evening? (Past Simple of be)
items.answer: Were you at home yesterday evening?

items.prompt: your neighbours / can / help / us? (can)
items.answer: Can your neighbours help us?

items.prompt: why / Ella / be / late / today? (Present Simple of be)
items.answer: Why is Ella late today?

blocks.title: 3 · Ask for the missing detail
blocks.instructions: Read each answer. Write the question that asks for the information in brackets.

items.prompt: “I live in Ufa.” (Where?)
“I usually finish work at six.” (When?)
items.answer: When do you usually finish work?

items.prompt: “Mia bought her camera in London.” (Where?)
items.answer: Where did Mia buy her camera?

items.prompt: “I am reading a travel blog.” (What?)
items.answer: What are you reading?

items.prompt: “There are four students in the room.” (How many students?)
items.answer: How many students are there in the room?

items.prompt: “Dan goes swimming twice a week.” (How often?)
items.answer: How often does Dan go swimming?

items.prompt: “I invited Oliver because he is my colleague.” (Why?)
items.answer: Why did you invite Oliver?

blocks.title: 4 · The alphabet: vowel sounds
blocks.instructions: Choose the word with the same main vowel sound as the name of each letter. Use British English letter names (Z is pronounced “zed”).

items.prompt: Letter A
Letter H
Letter G
Letter L
Letter Y
Letter O
Letter Q
Letter R

blocks.title: 5 · Who, which or that?
blocks.instructions: Tick ALL the relative pronouns that can complete each defining relative clause.

items.prompt: The actor … stars in this series. (Tick all possible pronouns.)

segments: took our photo has a studio nearby.
items.prompt: The photographer … took our photo has a studio nearby.
I bought a chair … folds flat.

segments: moved in last week are very friendly.
items.prompt: The neighbours … moved in last week are very friendly.
This is the app … helps me organise my week.
The chef … works here trained in Italy.
We visited a museum … displays old cameras.

blocks.title: 6 · Make one sentence from two
blocks.instructions: Join the two sentences with a defining relative clause. Use who, which or that. Keep all the information.

items.prompt: A teacher called me. She teaches French.
items.exampleTarget: A teacher who teaches French called me.

items.prompt: A neighbour found my wallet. She lives on the third floor.
items.answer: A neighbour who lives on the third floor found my wallet.
acceptedAnswers: A neighbour who lives on the third floor found my wallet.
A neighbour that lives on the third floor found my wallet.

items.prompt: I watched a documentary. It explains how volcanoes form.
items.answer: I watched a documentary which explains how volcanoes form.
acceptedAnswers: I watched a documentary which explains how volcanoes form.
I watched a documentary that explains how volcanoes form.

items.prompt: The children won the competition. They practise every weekend.
items.answer: The children who practise every weekend won the competition.
acceptedAnswers: The children who practise every weekend won the competition.
The children that practise every weekend won the competition.

items.prompt: We stayed in a hotel. It overlooks the river.
items.answer: We stayed in a hotel which overlooks the river.
acceptedAnswers: We stayed in a hotel which overlooks the river.
We stayed in a hotel that overlooks the river.

items.prompt: The woman is my new colleague. She is wearing a green coat.
items.answer: The woman who is wearing a green coat is my new colleague.
acceptedAnswers: The woman who is wearing a green coat is my new colleague.
The woman that is wearing a green coat is my new colleague.

items.prompt: I found a website. It offers free pronunciation practice.
items.answer: I found a website which offers free pronunciation practice.
acceptedAnswers: I found a website which offers free pronunciation practice.
I found a website that offers free pronunciation practice.

blocks.title: 7 · Find and correct the mistake
blocks.instructions: Each sentence contains ONE grammar mistake. Rewrite the WHOLE sentence correctly.

items.prompt: Did they took the wrong train?
items.exampleTarget: Did they take the wrong train?

items.prompt: Where does your sister works?
items.answer: Where does your sister work?

items.prompt: Did he went to the interview?
items.answer: Did he go to the interview?

items.prompt: Why you are tired today?
items.answer: Why are you tired today?

items.prompt: Who did called you last night?
items.answer: Who called you last night?

items.prompt: The man which lives opposite us is an architect.
items.answer: The man who lives opposite us is an architect.
acceptedAnswers: The man who lives opposite us is an architect.
The man that lives opposite us is an architect.

items.prompt: That’s the jacket who belongs to Mia.
items.answer: That’s the jacket which belongs to Mia.
acceptedAnswers: That’s the jacket which belongs to Mia.
That’s the jacket that belongs to Mia.

items.prompt: The students who studies online meet once a month.
items.answer: The students who study online meet once a month.
acceptedAnswers: The students who study online meet once a month.
The students that study online meet once a month.

items.prompt: The shop which sell second-hand books is near my office.
items.answer: The shop which sells second-hand books is near my office.
acceptedAnswers: The shop which sells second-hand books is near my office.
The shop that sells second-hand books is near my office.
